Marta (Product): Heads up — planning the multi-region model switch next Tue. Need a clear rollout choreography: feature-flag hierarchy, staged A/B sampling, per-tenant holdbacks, and an automatic fallback policy. Constraints: low-latency EU customers, Dedicated tenants must opt-in, Private deploys need KMS window. Can we sketch a minimal operational plan?

Samir (Eng): Proposal: region-by-region progression: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with at least 90m between big jumps. A/B cohorts by tenant/device to avoid correlated variance. Dedicated tenants behind an opt-in tenant flag. Warmup notes: cap batch sizes for first 2 ramps.

Jules (SRE): Telemetry gates suggestion: rollback if p95 latency increases >120ms AND error-rate >1.5x baseline sustained for 10m. Also immediate circuit-breaker if token throttles spike 3x. We'll need alerting + a pager rule for auto-rollback.

Anika (Customer Ops): Note: NordApps (EU enterprise) asked for a special path — 0% -> 2% -> hold -> 10% - they must be excluded from the main A/B cohort. Need per-tenant holdback flag and comms doc. Also request a manual approval step before they hit >2%.

Samir (Eng): Implementation plan: hierarchical flags (global root -> region slices -> tenant overrides). Example flag blueprint to implement (pseudo):
```
root_flag: on
region_eu: sample: 0.01, progression: [0.01,0.05,0.25,1.0]
tenant_overrides:
  nordapps: sample: 0.02, manual_gate: true
```
We'll also add a warmup-mode that forces smaller concurrency + disables large batching for the first 30m.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: branch feature/region-rollout-config pushed at 1761239900; CI: green; smoke tests: pass.

Marta (Product): Short checklist before schedule: 1) flag hierarchy + docs 2) telemetry gate definitions & thresholds 3) per-tenant exemption flow (NordApps) 4) SRE runbook + pager hooks 5) customer comms & approval path 6) post-ramp small evaluation prompts. Who takes each?

Samir (Eng): I'll own the flag PR + warmup-mode code. PR link will include rollout JSON and sample sizes.

Jules (SRE): I'll write the runbook and the alert rules, add a Slack webhook to #prod-rollouts and a pager on auto-rollback.

Anika (Customer Ops): I'll draft the NordApps note and the manual approval checklist, plus a short customer-facing FAQ.

Marta (Product): Great — final ask: please add a one-paragraph risk summary to the PR and tag me. I'll publish the tentative schedule by EOD Fri and loop in legal for the Private KMS window. :thumbsup:
